hypothesis: 11 aa; compact shape anchor. Replace the Tyr in SVQYNGQTVS with Phe and introduce a GP turn to test packing against V48/V49/V52 beside H50; charged termini support solubility.
expected_discrimination: Test compact MSA packing rather than generic exposure: 48–76 is 5.3–9.8 Å in MSA versus 30.4 Å in 8A9L. 6CU7 buries V48/V49/V52. Parent contrast was unfavorable (-2.4).

hypothesis: 11 aa; Leu/Tyr anchor with a PG turn and polar flanks. Targets the conserved 48–52 contour without requiring exposed A53, A76 or A78.
expected_discrimination: A compact pose could favor MSA over the separated 48–76 surfaces in 8A9L; 6CU7 occludes the local anchor. Local backbone similarity alone cannot establish selectivity.

hypothesis: 12 aa; separated Phe/Val packing elements and a constrained GP bend test a less flexible alternative to first-round glycine-rich peptides.
expected_discrimination: Seek contacts with accessible MSA V48/V49/H50/V52 without the assembly clashes seen previously. 8A9L lacks the nearby 76 surface; 6CU7 buries the valines.

hypothesis: 12 aa; a single Pro adjacent to Tyr tests a shallow bent interface around H50/G51, retaining soluble polar flanks rather than adding a long hydrophobic segment.
expected_discrimination: ESVYNGSTVQGSK favored 8A9L in round one (contrast -4.077); the Pro substitution tests shape restriction. MSA compaction and 6CU7 burial are hypotheses, not demonstrated advantages.

hypothesis: 14 aa; compact Leu/Tyr/Val core with charged extensions. Tests whether reduced core flexibility improves cross-MSA placement while extensions remain solvent-facing.
expected_discrimination: Require compatibility despite A53 SASA changing from 17.2 to 81.1–83.6 Å across MSA. Compact 48–76 geometry distinguishes 8A9L; buried 48–52 distinguishes 6CU7.

hypothesis: 10 aa; balanced-charge polar anchor. Asp/Tyr offers alternative hydrogen-bonding and aromatic interactions with exposed H50, while Pro constrains the local contour.
expected_discrimination: H50 is more exposed in 8A9L than MSA, so H50 binding alone is insufficient; test a geometry-dependent multi-contact pose. H50 exposure is much lower in 6CU7 (14.7 Å²).

hypothesis: 11 aa; Phe plus an His/Asp polar module tests pH-sensitive recognition of H50 with small residues accommodating G51. No target salt bridge is assumed.
expected_discrimination: Compare pH-dependent poses across all five structures: MSA H50 SASA is 86.4–92.4 Å² versus 158.1 in 8A9L and 14.7 in 6CU7. Selectivity must additionally depend on MSA packing.

hypothesis: 12 aa; Tyr/Asp/Gln anchoring with no glycine tests a less floppy polar scaffold. Modest net negative charge and isolated Val limit hydrophobic aggregation risk.
expected_discrimination: EVQYDSQTVK gave contrast -4.0; altered spacing tests that failure rather than assuming acidic anchoring works. Seek compact MSA contacts absent in 8A9L and inaccessible in 6CU7.

hypothesis: 12 aa; one Trp probes stronger aromatic contact with H50/V49, while Asp, Asn and Thr provide polar compensation. Avoids a continuous hydrophobic run.
expected_discrimination: Trp may also favor exposed 8A9L; retain only poses exploiting compact MSA topology. 6CU7 occludes V49 and most of the surrounding patch.

hypothesis: 14 aa; His/Asp and Tyr provide complementary polar/aromatic anchoring, with Pro testing a bent scaffold. Avoids dependence on variable A76/A78 exposure.
expected_discrimination: Test recognition of accessible MSA 48–52 plus its compact surroundings, not sequence identity. 8A9L separates 48 from 76 by 30.4 Å; 6CU7 buries 48–52.

hypothesis: 12 aa; alternative Trp/Val shape anchor with a PG turn. Builds on NQSYVTGQSN, whose MSA contacts were relatively consistent (0.5–0.7 per residue), but changes its flexible core.
expected_discrimination: Parent contrast was -2.1, so this tests—not predicts—improvement against exposed 8A9L. Compact MSA geometry and inaccessible 6CU7 anchors provide the proposed filters.

hypothesis: 14 aa; Leu substitution and Pro restriction retain the polar SQNY motif. Tests recovery of cross-MSA contacts rather than merely lowering control contacts.
expected_discrimination: SQNYVSGTQNSK had low 8A9L contacts but near-zero 6XYP/6XYQ contacts. Require improved worst-MSA contact density while preserving weaker compatibility with buried 6CU7 and separated 8A9L.

hypothesis: 16 aa; a compact Trp/Leu anchor embedded in a soluble polar scaffold. A GP turn tests whether longer peptides can avoid the extensive assembly clashes of round one.
expected_discrimination: Evaluate full assemblies: MSA A76/A78 are exposed in 6XYO but nearly buried in 6XYP/6XYQ, so they must remain optional contacts. 8A9L separation and 6CU7 burial are negative-selection features.

hypothesis: 18 aa; distributed Tyr/Leu/Val anchors and a single Pro allow peripheral adjustment while maintaining a constrained central contact near H50/G51.
expected_discrimination: ESQNYVGTNSQTVQSK retained contacts across MSA but had contrast -2.438. Test whether core restriction reduces 8A9L preference without demanding buried A76/A78 contacts in 6XYP/6XYQ; 6CU7 remains occluded.

hypothesis: 24 aa; long polar-tail alternative with a localized Phe/Leu turn-containing core. Tests whether nonbinding extensions can improve solubility without disrupting compact 48–52 anchoring.
expected_discrimination: The previous 22-aa peptide lost 6XYO contacts and had 11.182 assembly clashes per residue there. Require clash-free compatibility across MSA, weaker 8A9L binding despite its exposure, and exclusion from buried 6CU7.
